name: Vulcan Crusher
main_effect: [Main] Choose 1 of your Digimon. Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon with DP less than or equal to the chosen Digimon to its owner's hand. Then, by returning the top card of one of your [Leopardmon: Leopard Mode] to hand, unsuspend all of your Digimon.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, add this card to your hand.
